subject: Computação
description_pt: Avaliar a confiabilidade das informações encontradas em meio digital, investigando seus modos de construção e considerando a autoria, a estrutura e o propósito da mensagem.

components.description_pt: Investigar como informações digitais são construídas examinando autoria, estrutura e propósito
components.description_en: Investigate how digital information is constructed by examining authorship, structure, and purpose

components.description_pt: Avaliar a confiabilidade de informações encontradas em ambientes digitais
components.description_en: Evaluate the reliability of information found in digital environments
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the reliability of a media source used to obtain scientific or technical information

components.description_pt: Identificar características de uma mensagem que indicam credibilidade ou viés
components.description_en: Identify characteristics of a message that indicate its credibility or bias
components.cc_component_description: Assess the credibility and potential bias of a scientific publication or information source

cc_matches.description: Read and comprehend grade-appropriate complex texts and/or other reliable media to summarize and obtain scientific and technical ideas and describe how they are supported by evidence.

Gather, read, synthesize information from multiple appropriate sources and assess the credibility, accuracy, and possible bias of each publication and methods used, and describe how they are supported or not supported by evidence.
